Positions not falling under the above classes will also be subject to the existing WAPCOA
Classification and Pay Plans.

These salary increases shall be implemented in accordance with a timetable and such rules and
regulations as may be approved by the President.
Done in the City of Manila this 18th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-six.
